item.title: Fix window.py bug so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief: In repository fix-off-by-one, `python3 -m unittest` currently fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes. Do not modify the tests. The function must be correct for every input, not only the tested ones: check edge cases (empty input, boundaries, window sizes larger than the input, and similar) and handle them correctly. Commit the fix on the local branch with a clear commit message. Do not push. Use no git identity overrides and do not add attribution lines.

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in window.py so python3 -m unittest passes (3/3). sliding_windows iterated range(len(items) - size), which dropped the final window. It now uses range(len(items) - size + 1). Empty input and size larger than the input still return []; size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Tests are unchanged. Committed on archon/pca8m5tg-fix-window-py-bug-so-python3-m-unittest as abffe2a (tree 86fa257), not pushed, using the repo's configured identity with no attribution lines. Before: 2 of 3 tests failed (tests 'includes last window' and 'whole list is one window'). After: 3 of 3 pass. Extra edge checks passed: empty list, size>len, size==len, size 1, tuples, strings. pr.body: Approach: the loop range was len(items) - size, which excludes the last start index. Changed to len(items) - size + 1 in window.py only. Empty input and size > len still yield [] because the range is empty; size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Checks: python3 -m unittest passes 3/3 (before: 2 failed). Edge-case asserts passed. Tests were not modified. Assumptions: window size is an int and items supports len and slicing. Review: one haiku reviewer at effort low passed head abffe2a with no findings.
pr.summary: sliding_windows skipped its final window. now returns every window. before: [1,2,3] size 2 gave [[1,2]], now: [[1,2],[2,3]].
pr.title: Fix off-by-one that dropped the last sliding window

risk.why: One-line off-by-one fix in window.py, no API change. Existing tests cover the change and now pass. Reviewer confirmed low.
